question: NSQO is related to TYWU in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, JOMK is related to PUSQ. To which of the following options is LQOM related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

NSQO is related to TYWU 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2524adbf1190d5d4bb80de3cb00a6e1f76365cfb8818e71c2377ba69835fc655.png] 

JOMK is related to PUSQ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53f22605061e98dbfc7c3b2489c74172e4629f6493bcf9066a0f587ec94a621e.png] 

Similarly, LQOM will be related:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1b36979ebf454d9e065a5f330f882af2e48dc06d5fe01306421fb738d2dc13e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
